verdict.rationale: Entra documents Lifecycle Workflows that run automatically against users across the three phases of their lifecycle, which covers joiner/mover/leaver automation (docs-5, docs-18). It also documents automatic provisioning of users into SaaS and on-premises apps (docs-3, docs-26, docs-4). However, nothing in the pack shows an HRIS acting as the authoritative inbound source that drives these changes; the SCIM evidence describes outbound, app-facing provisioning. missing for 10: documented inbound HR-driven provisioning from an HRIS (e.g., Workday/SuccessFactors connectors) as source of truth, evidence that mover changes update app assignments automatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
